description: Start WeightedBatchPreprocessing (WBPP) headless in a separate PixInsight instance (PixInsight -n --automation-mode --force-exit) over input_dirs, writing into output_dir, and return a run id at once; wbpp_status reports the run. output_dir must lie inside <workspace>/output (a relative path is resolved there) or the state folder. Only the WBPP parameters given are passed; WBPP's own settings apply to the rest. Interactive local normalization and frame selection are turned off so nothing waits for a click. optimize_darks and drizzle_scale are applied to every light group by a generated pipeline-builder script. extra_params passes further WBPP automation parameters by name (BPP-Automation.js lists them). Refuses while the GUI instance runs a command for this workspace, and while an earlier run_wbpp run of this workspace is running. Tools that use the GUI instance keep working while WBPP runs.

drizzle_scale.description: Enable drizzle on every light group at this scale

frame_selection.description: Frame selection filters [{metric, value, compare}], compare less or greater (non-interactive)

input_dirs.description: Folders WBPP scans recursively for lights, darks, flats and bias (WBPP dir=)

keywords.description: Grouping keywords [{name, mode}], mode pre (calibration groups), post (integration groups) or prepost

optimize_darks.description: Set dark optimization on every light group

output_dir.description: WBPP output folder: relative to <workspace>/output, or absolute inside <workspace>/output or the state folder

reference.description: Automatic registration reference: one for all (auto) or one per value of reference_keyword

reference_image.description: Registration reference image file (WBPP referenceImage, manual reference)

name: run_wbpp
